notes.title: New OVERDRIVE Bundle Now Available!
notes.content:
Have you ever questioned if your life was really on the path you were meant to take? Have you ever pondered what music truly means to those who enjoy it, and those who create it?

If you've ever wondered what it might take to pursue your dreams, and if the risk is worth diverging from the path laid before you in life, then you'll find much in common with Kei, the protagonist of MUSICUS!, a deep, emotional visual novel about life's choices and the pursuit of music.

If you have yet to experience this thoughtful, coming of age story, then there's no better time than now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418180/MUSICUS/

All week long, MUSICUS! will be on sale for 60% off, and available as part of our newest OVERDRIVE bundle, encompassing all of this developer's titles available on Steam, such as Go Go Nippon, Bokuten, and more.

This is a great time to take advantage of our sale and complete your collection, so check them out today!
